newsitem.title: USA: Wash. Public says 1,158 MW nuke at full output.
newsitem.headline: Wash. Public says 1,158 MW nuke at full output.

text.p: Washington Public Power Supply System said Monday the Washington Nuclear 2 power plant (WNP-2) was operating at full output this past weekend despite a report indicating it had reduced power.
"We operated at 100 percent through the weekend," a Washington Public Power spokesman said.
In its daily plant status report today, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission said WNP-2 was trimmed to 63 percent of capacity over the weekend for inspection and replacement work on its feed pumps.
"We remained essentially at 100 percent power," the spokesman said, adding that to the best of his knowledge only work on the coils in the reactor's cooling system was performed last weekend.
WNP-2, in Ricland, Wa., is owned by a consortium of public utilities in the state.
